name: cover_move_shoot
about: A gunman fires while it moves to cover (the run-and-gun). The cover_armed staging: an armed player in the open, in the gunman's view for the whole run to the hint. Retail: CAI_BaseNPC::RunTaskOverlay 0x10289c90 runs with every RunTask and, while slot 575 ShouldMoveAndShoot passes (an enemy, flags2 0x400, the active weapon's word & 0x6000, CAP_MOVE_SHOOT), calls the move-and-shoot overlay 0x102e8560: AddGesture(TranslateActivity(0x1a)) on an overlay layer, Weapon_SetActivity(0x19), the 0x47 / 0x48 gestures; the shot is the LAYER's 3031 event, dispatched through 0x10098cd0 to slot 259 and the weapon's operator (stories/v4/packets-R2.md item 3; packets-S3.md items 1-4). So between the move task's start and its completion the trace carries animevent 3031 on the gunman. On the two witness maps the run-and-gun is reachable only on sp_tutorial_1, by nine placed rows (thug_3 with item_w_thirtyeight; Hunter1, sentry3, sabbat_redshirt_1, _2, _5, sabbat_redshirt_2_proxy with item_w_mac_10; mercenary_upstairs with item_w_ithaca_m_37; condotierre_upstairs with item_w_steyr_aug), none on the hub with a ranged primary (packets-S4.md item d); the arena gunman stands for thug_3 (the same class and weapon).
known_red: V4o O2: slot 575 never passes -- FElysiumNpc::ShouldMoveAndShoot reads ActiveWeaponCapabilityWord(), a seam answering 0, so the overlay never arms; then V4o O1 (the NPC has no overlay layers)
notes: The run to the hint takes 2.7 s here (TASK_WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT 0.5 -> 3.2 s on the seam's build, the goal ~412 cm off); `shoots_moving` is bound inside it (2.6 s after the move task starts), so the shot from cover that follows the arrival (TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1, ~1.5 s later) cannot meet it, and `arrives` must come after the shot. J5 (stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4): the overlay is a counter in V4; this record is the bug protocol's red.
